$comment: Where each marketplace of a plugin in plugins.json comes from (#2378).
Name to source, the source in the form `claude plugin marketplace add`
takes. Before the first install from a marketplace, `dotf deploy` adds it
from here when the box does not register it, and refreshes it when it does.
A fresh Claude Code no longer registers claude-plugins-official on its own.
Its own file, not a plugins.json field: every released dotf reads
plugins.json strictly, so a new field there fails the plugin step on a box
whose binary predates it. Every plugin's marketplace must be listed here
